basedOn.description: meta.version of the target this proposal was made against

note.description: Updates left on this record, oldest first: a few words on how it is going, with who wrote them and when. Append-only: a note is added, never changed or removed by someone else's edit. Anyone who may edit the record may add one. For a message addressed to people, with replies or attachments, use Communication.

title: BIX v0.1 data types
description: Shared data types. Domain in $id is provisional until the BIX site exists.

id.description: Assigned where the record is created, including offline. Never reused.

reference.description: {Type}/{id}, or a full URL on another BIX server.

system.description: bayanihan:{value-set}, a module namespace, or a URL. Never 'bix'.

Identifier.description: A short reference people can say, e.g. LU-24.

Extension.description: A namespaced addition. May never redefine a core element.

previousHash.description: SHA-256 of the previous version's RFC 8785 canonical form.

language.description: BCP 47, e.g. fil or en. Mixed Filipino-English is fil.

Signature.description: A group's server or hub signature over a record's RFC 8785 canonical form.
